description: Shared Renovate preset of the repositories that use these workflows: weekly updates on Monday morning, nothing published less than 3 days ago, actions pinned to a commit SHA. A consumer extends it pinned to a release, `github>KevinDeBenedetti/github-workflows//renovate/default#vX.Y.Z`, and propagate-release moves that tag with its workflow pins. See docs/workflows/renovate.md.

customManagers.description: prek hook revs in a prek.toml, each under an inline `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` comment. No manager understands prek's TOML, so without this the hook pins only move when someone remembers to run `prek autoupdate`.

packageRules.description: KevinDeBenedetti/github-workflows moves with its own releases: in each consumer, propagate-release opens the pull request that moves its workflow pins, its prek.toml hooks and this preset's tag together; in this repository, the workflows reach their own actions with `uses: $/…` and release-please bumps the examples. Renovate would only duplicate them.
